results.name: Sci-fi Weapon | Firearm  | Game Ready
results.description:
The primary weapon of Operation Icarus is a sci-fi rifle designed with a strong, functional silhouette suited for a protagonist operating in a tactical futuristic world. Its compact, angular form is defined by clean lines and sharp contours, giving it a modern and purposeful look.

Built from a combination of high-strength plastic polymers and metal components, the rifle balances durability with a lightweight feel. Matte plastic panels make up the main body, contrasted by exposed metallic parts such as the rails, barrel, and mechanical joints.

Industrial details like visible screws, technical engravings, textured grips, and a digital sight enhance the realism of the design. A compact magazine, ergonomic handles, and subtle color accents help distinguish functional elements without compromising the clean aesthetic.

The result is a refined blend of military utility and sci-fi sophistication, grounded in a believable narrative universe.
